import sys
import itertools

def solve(line):
    nums = [int(x) for x in line.split()]
    nums.sort(reverse=True)
    results = []
    for perm in itertools.permutations(nums):
        results.append(' '.join(map(str, perm)))
    return results

data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
if not data:
    sys.exit(0)
line = data[0].strip()
if not line:
    sys.exit(0)
res = solve(line)
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(res))
if res:
    sys.stdout.write('\n')
